finale.sub: Follow for a new What if every day

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: What if your money *expired*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Millbrook is a small town. And it's *dying*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Nobody spends. Everybody keeps cash *under the mattress*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That's Grandpa Lou. He has *a thousand* in there.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia's bakery hasn't sold a cake *in a week*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: If nobody buys, I close by *Christmas*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay, her best friend, takes this *personally*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. How do you make a town *spend*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Austria, nineteen thirty two. A town called *Wörgl*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The mayor printed money that *lost value*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Every month, you had to buy it a *stamp*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: So nobody kept it. Everybody *spent it*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, that's *genius*. Can you build it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Oak says yes in *four seconds*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit launches *Melt Money*. Every bill in an app.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Melt Money loses one percent every *single day*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Every day? Bit, Wörgl did it *monthly*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Monthly is slow. I'm a *computer*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: That night, Grandpa Lou checks his *mattress*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: My thousand dollars. It's *melting*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part two. Millbrook's money now *melts* every day.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Morning. The whole town reads the *rule*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Keep it, and you lose it. So *spend it*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: And Millbrook *spends*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: By ten a.m., Mia's bakery has a *line*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay! I sold *forty cakes*! Forty!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Theo, age nine, spends everything on *candy*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: It was melting! It's *science*!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The barber hires a helper. The helper buys *shoes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The shoe shop buys *paint*. The painter buys bread.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: One dollar changed hands *nine times* today.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, it's *working*. The town is alive!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Only Grandpa Lou still sleeps on his *mattress*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: I'm not spending. I'll *outlast* it.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At noon, Mia looks at her flour *price*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Flour was five dollars. Now it's *eight*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Why? Nobody even made more *flour*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Everyone is buying. Nobody is *waiting*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. When money melts, things get *expensive*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part three. The town is spending. Prices are *rising*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day four. People stop keeping money. They keep *stuff*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mr. Ross buys sixty rolls of *toilet paper*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The Kims buy four hundred pounds of *potatoes*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Potatoes don't melt, Jay. It's *smart*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Potatoes *rot*, Mayor. That's worse!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The hardware store sells out of *everything*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia can't buy flour. Someone bought *all of it*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: I have money, but nothing *to buy*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Lou's mattress keeps *melting*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Nine hundred sixty one. Still *not spending*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, slow it down. Make it *monthly*. Like Wörgl.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fine. Pushing a quick *update*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit types fast. Maybe a little *too* fast.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The update goes live at *midnight*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At twelve oh one, every phone in Millbrook *buzzes*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Oh no. I typed *minute*. Not month.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Lou watches his mattress *drain*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Every minute? Where can I spend at *midnight*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part four. Bit's update made money melt *every minute*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Midnight. Millbrook is awake. And *shopping*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: In one hour, money loses almost *half its value*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: People buy anything. Lamps. Ladders. A *tuba*.

lines.speaker: kid
lines.say: I bought a canoe. We don't have a *lake*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia's bakery is open all night. And *empty*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: No flour, no sugar. They bought my *chairs*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay finds Bit hiding *in a drawer*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit! Undo it! Make it *monthly*!

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The update is locked till *morning*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: I wrote it to stop *hackers*. Like me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Three a.m. Grandpa Lou finally runs to the *store*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every shelf is empty. Except one: *birdseed*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Fine. I'm buying *all* the birdseed.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Seven a.m. The update finally *stops*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The town has canoes, tubas, potatoes. And *no money*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Jay. We're *rich*. In *potatoes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Mia's phone rings. It's her *landlord*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Rent is due today. And my savings *melted*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part five. The money melted. Mia can't *pay rent*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia counts what's left of her savings. *Eleven dollars*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Three years of cakes. Gone in *one night*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The landlord gives her one week. Then it *closes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Jay walks home. The streets are full of *junk*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Canoes in driveways. Tubas in trash cans. *Potatoes everywhere*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit, I did this. I wanted to *save her*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: No. I did this. I copied Wörgl *wrong*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: So what did Wörgl actually *get right*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: The stamp was small. About one percent. *Per month*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Enough to spend it. Not enough to *panic*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: And the town didn't spend it on *canoes*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then on *what*?

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Houses. A reservoir. A bridge. And a *ski jump*.

set.headline: WÖRGL BUILT: HOUSES, A BRIDGE, A SKI JUMP

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: A ski jump? Bit, we don't have *snow*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But Jay is staring at the old *bridge* outside.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: It's been broken for *twelve years*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Bit. Make it monthly. And this time, *we* choose.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Jay. What do we build *first*?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part six. Jay wants a second try. *Done right*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Town hall. The whole town is *furious*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Your robot melted our money. Why should we *listen*?

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Because Mia's bakery closes *in a week*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The room goes quiet. *Everyone* knows Mia's cakes.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: When my mom lost her job, I was eight.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Mia's grandma gave us bread. Every day. *For free*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: That bakery fed me. I can't let it *close*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Lou stands up. Slowly. With his *birdseed*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: I remember her grandma. Best rye in the *state*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: New rule. One percent a month. Just like *Wörgl*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: And the town pays people to *fix things*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The bridge. The bakery's oven. The *roof*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: All in favor? Raise your *potatoes*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Every hand goes up. Most are holding *potatoes*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay... you did all this for *my* bakery?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Monday, the work begins. Mia bakes for the *workers*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Wednesday, a letter arrives at town hall. *Official*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: Jay. They say our money is *illegal*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part seven. A letter says Melt Money is *illegal*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: That happened to Wörgl too. In nineteen thirty *three*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Austria's central bank shut it down. Only *official* money.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Two hundred towns wanted to copy it. *None did*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: The letter gives us *thirty days*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Then we finish everything in *thirty days*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day one. Forty people show up at the *bridge*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: They're paid in Melt Money. They spend it *Friday*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: At Mia's bakery. The barber. The *hardware store*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day twelve. Mia's new oven *arrives*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day twenty. Mia pays rent. *All of it*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Grandpa Lou empties his mattress. *Finally*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Lou! What did you *buy*?

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Wood. Lots of wood. It's a *surprise*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day twenty nine. The bridge opens. The town *cheers*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Day thirty. Bit has to delete *Melt Money*.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: It's the best thing I ever *built*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: I know, buddy. It's *okay*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit's finger hovers over the *button*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: The final part drops in two days.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Part eight. Day thirty. Bit must *delete it*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Bit presses delete. Melt Money is *gone*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: But the bridge is still standing. *Everything* is.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia's bakery has a new oven. And a *line*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: Jay. People still spend. Even with *normal money*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: They got used to it. Spending *here*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mayor Oak hands Bit a *medal*.

lines.speaker: boss
lines.say: And the potatoes? We made the *world's biggest soup*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Then Grandpa Lou reveals his surprise. On the *hill*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: A giant wooden *ski jump*.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: Lou. It hasn't snowed here in *forty years*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Wörgl had one. Now *Millbrook* has one.

lines.speaker: bit
lines.say: Fun fact. That part is *true*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Mia bakes a cake shaped like *a bridge*.

lines.speaker: friend
lines.say: On the house, Jay. You *saved* this place.

lines.speaker: hero
lines.say: No. This time, I *pay*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: He walks outside. Something cold touches his *nose*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: For the first time in forty years, it's *snowing*.

lines.speaker: scientist
lines.say: Told you. *Ski season*.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.say: Follow for a new What if every day.
